description: Full roster of insiders who have ever filed a Form 4 for a given ticker — name, CIK, titles, director/officer/10%-owner flags, last-filed date, and total transaction count per insider. Use this to enumerate a company's insiders (e.g. before pulling each one's career summary); use get_transactions with ticker= for the underlying trade history itself. Free plan. Paginated, max 100/page.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. MSFT.

name: get_company_insiders
